en: Black-and-white waterside scene showing a small Nordic town with wooden houses along a stone embankment. Two early-20th‑century cars are parked by a road in front of the houses. On the right, a larger multi-storey house stands partly on stilts over the water, whose still surface clearly reflects the buildings. Trees and low wooded hills appear in the background. The caption "STENUNGSUND." is printed at the bottom left, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 3494 is at the bottom right.
